name: Nam Định

queries.query: Nam Dinh Vietnam official cadastral parcel map GIS land registration map API
queries.result: Search found official Vietnamese government land-information procedures and the Nam Định provincial environment portal, but no anonymous Nam Định parcel map/API or city-bounded ID-plus-geometry response.

queries.query: Nam Định bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức
queries.result: Search found the official Nam Định provincial land/environment portal, a provincial land-data management regulation, and official records describing the provincial land-registration office; no public anonymous parcel geometry service was exposed.

officialSources.observation: Official provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment portal; its footer identifies the Nam Định provincial authority and its land-resource section publishes cadastral/land documents. Direct GET from this environment failed TLS certificate-chain verification; no exception was used.

Official provincial decision describing the Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai (land registration office) as responsible for land registration, cadastral records, cadastral-map correction and land-information management. This is local custodian evidence, not an open parcel API.

Official national public-service procedure for requesting surveying/mapping information through the national surveying and mapping data center; procedure evidence only, not city-bounded open parcel geometry.
Official national geospatial portal information page. General national geospatial prose does not establish Nam Định cadastral coverage or an anonymous parcel endpoint.

requests.outcome: Server certificate chain contained an untrusted/self-signed certificate from this environment. TLS verification was not disabled and no content was used as fetched evidence.
Official national surveying/mapping data-request route did not return within the bounded anonymous request. No retry escalation, login, or certificate bypass.
Non-government GIS provider API page loaded; it advertises coordinate-based cadastral lookup, but it is not evidenced as the Nam Định registry custodian and no parcel request was made or retained.
Documented the provincial land-registration office mandate; no machine-readable parcel response.

registryBasis: A local Nam Định land-registration office and provincial land/environment custodian are evidenced by official provincial documents and portal pages. Anonymous public parcel geometry, schema, CRS and city scope were not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Nam Định provincial land/environment portal, provincial land-registration-office mandate, and national surveying/geospatial information procedures.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No city-bounded Nam Định parcel record, stable native parcel identity, safe schema, CRS or geometry was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: The local cadastral database may exist and may be available through an authenticated or request-based workflow, but endpoint, access policy, schema, CRS and city coverage remain unknown. Zero exact-point hits, timeout and TLS failure are not evidence of citywide absence.
identityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. Future retained samples may contain only one stable native parcel ID plus full native geometry, with source field mapping documented in the review.
